Dataset-related endpoints, divided by admin and normal users. The only difference is the token used (admin_token and user_token) which are automatically set by General -> Admin login and General -> Login

item.name: General
item.description:
This is the starting point for interacting with the FN. Needs to have

``` bash
kubectl port-forward -n federated-nginx svc/ingress-nginx-controller 443

 ```

to run on a terminal. You can set `base_url` env var to set the url root
